channel.title: The Startfall Universe
channel.description: Last 10 notes on The Startfall Universe

item.title: Aaron
item.description: A living stream given shape, Aaron moves like a sculpted tide — his form shifting between dolphin-sleek grace and humanoid structure, skin resembling flowing water caught in perpetual motion.

item.title: Asterion
item.description: Asterion was born human during the Age of First Civilizations, around 12,000 BCE, and became exceptionally long-lived through unknown astral magic.

item.title: Bogrund
item.description: Bogrund is a mustachioed engineer who treats his mechanized armor and his trusty mace, Bonk, like family.

item.title: CR-9
item.description: CR-9 is a relic of the Molten Imperium — built, unlike Rhaegor, not as a guardian but as the empire’s forward siege engine, designed to level mountains so its armies could advance.

item.title: Garvak
item.description: Garvak believes that strength alone proves worthiness — “Stand firm.

item.title: Ka'Ruun
item.description: Ka’Ruun is a biomechanical scorpion-titan, bred long ago by an ancient subterranean civilization to shatter cities through flawless ballistic geometry.

item.title: Krysta
item.description: Beneath Ashenvale Pyrehold stood the Eternis Core, a colossal living crystal older than any mortal tongue, said to keep calamity at bay by its mere existence.

item.title: Lumia
item.description: Lumia descends from the preservation-focused sect that split from The Celestial Concord after Asterion’s warnings went unheeded.

item.title: Rhaegor
item.description: Rhaegor survived the Starfall and remained within his volcano in Ashenvale Pyrehold as the world around him collapsed into the Shattered Age.

item.title: Serathiel
item.description: Serathiel is a disciplined, immaculate archer descended from The Celestial Concord’s judgment-focused sect — the philosophical inheritance left behind when Asterion’s warnings were dismissed and the order fractured.
